# AWS Transfer Family

Store SFTP server, service-managed user, public-key and tag configuration without a file-transfer runtime.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `transfer` |
| Signing name | `transfer` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2018-11-05` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 15 of 71 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-transfer-family) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SFTP/FTP/FTPS/AS2 listener, authentication, authorization, file transfers, runtime State/readiness, endpoint DNS/IP allocation, host private keys/fingerprints, metrics or successful start/stop stub.
- Only explicit SFTP/PUBLIC and a finite fixed policy set; VPC/EFS/certificates/custom identity, logging, workflow/connector, IP/storage/protocol advanced options are excluded, even false/null/empty.
- HomeDirectory is an explicit stored absolute path, not verified files; no IAM trust/existence enforcement, logical mappings, policies, POSIX or sessions. PATH is the fixed local directory-type default.
- CF SshPublicKeys is excluded; independently imported public-key IDs survive updates and live-state compensation. CF banner removal is rejected; explicit empty clears it.
- The [records guide](../guides/transfer-records.md) lists every member/default/error/tag/key/CF boundary and executable CLI lifecycle. StartServer/StopServer and additional runtime/records scope remain [future work](../roadmap/services/transfer-runtime.md).

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
